d: Chayan Rastogi brings you the most honest, most unfiltered movie review of Ramayana Part 1, starring Ranbir Kapoor as Ram, Yash as Ravana and Sai Pallavi as Mata Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, this 4,000 crore epic promises a never-seen-before cinematic experience. Is this Ramayana everything Adipurush failed to be? Aur sabse bada sawaal – is Yash's Ravana more impressive than Ranbir Kapoor's Ram?
